prerequisites: 父先封存当前nativeH16 baseline，所有新arm独立source身份/输出/actorSHA/配置SHA
同一物理点、同backend、同tick及8子步采样：old command/reward/pre-reset state/next command不可混
coordinate getter/quaternion/root-link vs COM的实际验证，不根据字段名猜错
E2 imagined command按原nonholonomic公式和预测heading/phase/timer演化；自然resample边界显式切段，不重采RNG
CURB113 only：ONE fresh reset后且first action前执行原axis binding；仅同步无noise command[:3]，无额外reset/obscompute/RNG；父处理备用候选与receipt
原接受observer与UID、terminal/censor规则验证；E0/S50原binary缺口不造proxy

comparisons.change: coordinate/command semantics only after prerequisite receipts
comparisons.purpose: isolate protocol repair from reward effects

comparisons.single_changed_factor: one broad tracking exponential replaced by rational kernel
comparisons.keep: original broad weight, tight, hard gap, square, command, termination, DR and physics
comparisons.risk: heavier positive tail can reward bad tracking/standing; original square already has nonzero gradient

comparisons.single_changed_factor: orientation cost finite multiplier during original exogenous request
comparisons.keep: original height/z masks, event, 3s request, 25 consecutive good controls, .03/.2/gz thresholds, normal recipe12 exclusion, original term masks, commands, action costs, DR and physics
comparisons.risk: weaker pose cost may increase fall/chatter despite recovery progress; credited outcome is not delta

comparisons.progress_reference: validated original wheel-link coordinate/route orientation and stored same-UID origin; not future success
comparisons.length_reason: own original endpoint span 2*edge; shaping parameter only, never an acceptance threshold
comparisons.boundary_requirement: no reset joins; command/reference change in augmented state or rigorously consistent option boundary; no arbitrary dropping of a transition
comparisons.keep: original reward labels available separately, ordered endpoint wheel/Fz acceptance, up/down/stand, mirror groups, physics, DR, original termination/timeout semantics
comparisons.risk: progress without endpoint contact, learned-WM reward exploitation, bootstrap/gamma/continuation mismatch; no generic invariance claim

comparisons.single_changed_factor: one BODY-interval progress or phase candidate, not both
comparisons.precondition: original natural interval origin/heading, negative BODY sign+pi, terminal and UID validated
comparisons.risk: interval censoring/low-speed tolerance and ground phase can disguise no progress
comparisons.keep: 12..16s natural sampler, uniform BODY vx[-.3,.3], .2 stand, accepted interval predicate and conditional denominator

comparisons.change: bounded source/command/reward diagnostics only until OWN acceptance authority found

comparisons.single_changed_factor: one quadratic tracking cost replaced by normalized Huber only after weight/scale calibration
comparisons.warning: unbounded cost with bounded nonzero tail slope; clipping makes zero-slope tail; replacing square may weaken correction

per_arm_design.budget: equal parent-approved budget; no training here
per_arm_design.seeds: paired parent-preregistered seeds plus independent holdout; same original init/DR/RNG distributions
report: all-started attempt ledger separate from original conditional denominator
ordinary failures and post-success failures separately
command exposure and actual speed distribution
base reward vs shaping and term-rate distributions
heldout reward residual/done calibration/WM multistep error
per_arm_design.promotion: original accepted groups improve with uncertainty reported, no hidden exposure shrink/ordinary-failure regression; E0/S50 no binary90 claim
stop_or_do_not_promote: original predicate not improved despite imagined reward rise
acceptance authority still missing for a claimed binary rate
